query.description: 작은 배치 도형 다건 추가 (좌표 2,000바이트=125점 이하 / ExecuteMultiple / 좌표 16진수 문자열을 HEXTORAW)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, SOURCE_ELEMENT_ID, LAYER_ID, DATA_TYPE, ELEMENT_TYPE, CLOSED_FLAG, PATH_WIDTH, PATH_TYPE, MIN_X, MIN_Y, MAX_X, MAX_Y, POINT_COUNT, POINTS_FORMAT_VERSION, POINTS_BIN, TEXT_VALUE, TEXT_TYPE, TEXT_FONT, TEXT_HORIZONTAL, TEXT_VERTICAL) VALUES (:factory, :device_id, :placed_element_id, :source_element_id, :layer_id, :data_type, :element_type, :closed_flag, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:path_width), :path_type, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:min_x), TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:min_y), TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:max_x), TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:max_y), :point_count, :points_format_version, HEXTORAW(:points_hex), :text_value, :text_type, :text_font, :text_horizontal, :text_vertical)

query.description: 큰 배치 도형 / 긴 TEXT 한 건 추가 (BLOB / Execute1 / 같은 키가 있으면 건너뜀). 다건 저장 실패 후 재시도에도 사용
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, SOURCE_ELEMENT_ID, LAYER_ID, DATA_TYPE, ELEMENT_TYPE, CLOSED_FLAG, PATH_WIDTH, PATH_TYPE, MIN_X, MIN_Y, MAX_X, MAX_Y, POINT_COUNT, POINTS_FORMAT_VERSION, POINTS_BIN, TEXT_VALUE, TEXT_TYPE, TEXT_FONT, TEXT_HORIZONTAL, TEXT_VERTICAL) SELECT :factory, :device_id, :placed_element_id, :source_element_id, :layer_id, :data_type, :element_type, :closed_flag, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:path_width), :path_type, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:min_x), TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:min_y), TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:max_x), TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:max_y), :point_count, :points_format_version, :points_bin, :text_value, :text_type, :text_font, :text_horizontal, :text_vertical FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL WHERE FACTORY = :chk_factory AND DEVICE_ID = :chk_device_id AND PLACED_ELEMENT_ID = :chk_placed_id)

query.description: 완료 확정: Device의 배치 도형 수 / 좌표 수 합계
query.commandtext: SELECT COUNT(*) AS PLACED_COUNT, NVL(SUM(POINT_COUNT), 0) AS POINT_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id

SELECT PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, POINT_COUNT, POINTS_BIN, PATH_WIDTH, MIN_X, MAX_Y, TEXT_VALUE FROM TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND PLACED_ELEMENT_ID = :placed_element_id

query.description: 조회 화면: Layer의 첫 페이지 (빈 문자열은 Oracle에서 NULL이라 첫 페이지를 별도 쿼리로 둔다)
query.commandtext: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, SOURCE_ELEMENT_ID, LAYER_ID, DATA_TYPE, ELEMENT_TYPE, CLOSED_FLAG, PATH_WIDTH, PATH_TYPE, MIN_X, MIN_Y, MAX_X, MAX_Y, POINT_COUNT, POINTS_FORMAT_VERSION, POINTS_BIN, TEXT_VALUE, TEXT_TYPE, TEXT_FONT, TEXT_HORIZONTAL, TEXT_VERTICAL FROM TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND LAYER_ID = :layer_id ORDER BY PLACED_ELEMENT_ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= :max_rows

query.description: 조회 화면: Layer의 다음 페이지 (이전 페이지 마지막 PLACED_ELEMENT_ID 다음부터)
query.commandtext: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, SOURCE_ELEMENT_ID, LAYER_ID, DATA_TYPE, ELEMENT_TYPE, CLOSED_FLAG, PATH_WIDTH, PATH_TYPE, MIN_X, MIN_Y, MAX_X, MAX_Y, POINT_COUNT, POINTS_FORMAT_VERSION, POINTS_BIN, TEXT_VALUE, TEXT_TYPE, TEXT_FONT, TEXT_HORIZONTAL, TEXT_VERTICAL FROM TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND LAYER_ID = :layer_id AND PLACED_ELEMENT_ID > :after_id ORDER BY PLACED_ELEMENT_ID) WHERE ROWNUM <= :max_rows

query.description: Device의 배치 도형 전체 삭제 (기존 데이터 삭제 후 재등록, Chain Member / Edit은 FK CASCADE)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id
